finding: V42.24 was safe but stalled: the connected TypeScript cluster reached two attempts with last_result=no_safe_candidates while the accepted repository did not improve.
root_cause: The V42.24 coordinated transaction still called the V42.16 single-file real-failure replay inside each provisional file candidate. A correct App.tsx change could be rejected because the whole project error set was unchanged before the hook/view edits were staged.
v4225_fix: Defer only the single-file whole-project replay/delta during provisional cluster assembly; preserve base ownership, syntax, and semantic-role gates; measure and atomically commit the complete candidate set only when global TypeScript diagnostics decrease.
